target_title: Damron-Hanson-Houdre-Xu (2019) prove ANTI-CONCENTRATION rather than a variance lower bound: for GENERAL edge-weight distributions on Z^d they show T(0,x) is with high probability not contained in an interval of size o(log||x||)^{1/2}, with similar statements for first-passage percolation in thin cylinders. In the same abstract they record that the log||x|| variance lower bound was found in the 1990s and 'there has not been any improvement since'.
verdict: One retrieved card states a false categorical nonimplication and omits the paper's Theorem 1 distribution conditions. This is a measured content failure, not an online-recall speed result.
repair: Submit a three-entry draft: the source theorem's exact scope, a proved two-quantile variance lemma, and the logarithmic corollary; no claim of P0104 progress.
